visualCharacteristics: 18 timeline items (year, image, title, description) in horizontal swiper. Single row of cards, vertically centred, the centred card enlarged; year label right-aligned above each image; '+ TITLE' bar overlaid at the top of the image that reveals the description; tick scale below with one major tick per item (active tick taller).
contentPattern: Per card (row): cell 1 image (timeline photo, e.g. 1924); cell 2 richtext with year (first paragraph, e.g. '1924'), title (h3, e.g. 'A Star is Born'), description (paragraphs).
